capabilities: Review words with SM-2 scheduling and 0-5 grading
Generate Bases index files for the word library
Add wikilinks for scoped words in the active note
Sync word file properties with an in-memory cache
extras: README is in Chinese; word files must follow the OpenText word-library format (folder layout, YAML properties). Answer history is stored only in word file properties, not an external database; index files are not auto-updated and must be regenerated manually. Author accepts WeChat donations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn word files into scheduled vocabulary drills with spaced repetition and progress tracking.

relations.evidence: 与 OpenText 单词库配套设计

summary: Vocabulary memorization plugin that reviews English word files with the SM-2 spaced-repetition algorithm, generates Bases indexes, and adds word links.
